$Comment: The Holtzman field hum, heard by the other players (positional). The world sound of an entity effect must be mono, and the requested Void_Static_Loop_Stereo_01 is stereo (the effect would not load), so this one uses the vanilla mono loop Portal_Void_LOOP_2 (a Void loop, 29 s); the owner hears Void_Static_Loop_Stereo_01 in the _Local event. Applied and stopped by the entity effect Arrakis_Holtzman_Field. Volume -8.5 dB (it was -12: 50% more amplitude, +3.5 dB).
